# Κτήμα Κουτσόγιωργα (Ktima Koutsogiorga)

> Family winery in Karyes, on the slopes of Mount Parnon, Greece. The public site is currently a pre-launch "coming soon" page that collects email signups for launch notification.

Primary content language is Greek (el). The only interactive element on the landing page is an email signup form. There is no catalogue, pricing, or online ordering yet. Individual wine pages exist and carry EU-compliant ingredient and nutrition data, but are not yet linked from the landing page.

## Wines

- [Mandolino (Μαντολίνο)](https://www.ktimakoutsogiorga.gr/wines/mandolino): Red, Cabernet Sauvignon 60% / Merlot 40%, 13.5% ABV, aged in French oak.
- [Livia's Rosé](https://www.ktimakoutsogiorga.gr/wines/livias-rose): Rosé, Cabernet Sauvignon 55% / Merlot 45%, 12.5% ABV.
- [Oinous (Οινούς)](https://www.ktimakoutsogiorga.gr/wines/oenous): White, Assyrtiko, 13% ABV.
- [Kores (Κόρες)](https://www.ktimakoutsogiorga.gr/wines/kores): White, Assyrtiko & Kydonitsa, 12.5% ABV.
- [Kato Rachi (Κάτω Ράχη)](https://www.ktimakoutsogiorga.gr/wines/kato-rachi): White, Kydonitsa, 12% ABV.

## Optional

- [Landing page](https://www.ktimakoutsogiorga.gr/): Pre-launch page with the email signup form.
- [Contact](mailto:couchellwinery@gmail.com): Direct email to the winery.

## Notes

- Alcoholic beverage content. Some jurisdictions restrict advertising to adults of legal drinking age.
- Ingredient and nutrition data on wine pages follows EU wine labelling requirements and should not be reproduced as general dietary advice.
